mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_replies (message_id, channel_id, workspace_id, author_id, content_html) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{channelId}, #{workspaceId}, #{authorId}, #{contentHtml})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, channel_id, workspace_id, author_id, content_html, edited_at, created_at FROM chat_replies WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.message_id, r.channel_id, r.author_id, r.content_html, r.edited_at, r.created_at, u.name AS author_name FROM chat_replies r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.author_id WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
